conviction_note: No news and no filing since 2026-09-23. The only sourced thing that bears on the window is the issuer's own share count: Class A went from 903,642 after the 2026-07-02 1-for-9 consolidation to 6,771,947 by 2026-09-17, about 7.5x in eleven weeks, fed by secured convertible notes and reset warrants that are still outstanding. Since the second 1-for-9 consolidation on 2026-09-28 the stock has fallen on almost every drop day, and six of this name's last seven non-split drops were down again at the next close. So p_up is 38 on a 12-point absolute move. The low volume (0.19x) cuts the other way and holds p_up nearer 50 than the name's own history alone would.

findings.finding: Ongoing conversion and warrant supply. Class A shares outstanding rose about 7.5x in eleven weeks (903,642 on 2026-07-02 to 6,771,947 on 2026-09-17), fed by secured convertible notes (Series A/C/D) with share-paid interest and warrants with reset and anti-dilution terms, all proportionately adjusted for and surviving the 2026-09-28 consolidation. No document says the issuance stopped, so more shares can reach a ~752k-share float in the 2026-10-12 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The supply is continuous rather than scheduled. Conversions and interest-in-shares settle and can be sold in every session, the next one included, and nothing in the record (no redemption, no exchange, no notes-retired 6-K) has turned it off. The weekend before the window also gives the issuer three days in which to furnish a 6-K.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: From the sealed baseline's own falls, excluding consolidation artefacts (-87% to -89% rows): 2026-09-01 -6.82, 09-08 -9.79, 09-09 -8.76, 09-24 -5.18, 09-30 -7.25, 10-08 -13.40 at the next close. 2026-07-31 (+3.08) is the only up case among those seven. Over all 123 comparable drops the median is -1.85% and the up-rate 43.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's price holds the shares sold so far, not the ones still to come. Nothing on file caps the conversion flow, and the stock has already lost about a quarter of its value in five sessions without any news. If the market were pricing the end of the supply, a low-volume flush like today's would be followed by bids. In this name's post-consolidation history it has instead been followed by another down close.
findings.independence: Same issuer, different documents. The 2026-03-13 Series D note terms (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1928581/000149315226009988/form6-k.htm) and the 2026-06-09 PIPE warrants with reset provisions (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1928581/000149315226027954/form6-k.htm) name the instruments. The jump in pre-split ADV to 3.14m at the 2026-09-15 settlement fits heavy issuance into the market. All of it traces back to the issuer, so this is not independent confirmation.

outside_window.finding: A third consolidation is likely if dilution continues at this pace: two 1-for-9 consolidations 88 days apart (2026-07-02, 2026-09-28), authorised Class A of 940.7m shares against 752k issued, and the board approved the September one without a shareholder vote. No date has been announced.
Further PIPE closings of up to $8m on the June terms, plus remaining Series D tranches (up to $1.75m) that need mutual agreement. These are open-ended with no date.
